verdict.rationale: The reemployment tax eServices page offers a 'Document Lookup' that finds filed returns or payments by Reemployment Tax Number, FEIN/ITIN, and Confirmation Number, plus a view of employer return and payment history, so a founder can confirm a filing was received. Registration applications, by contrast, sit behind an authenticated login, and nothing in the evidence covers case status. missing for 10: status lookup for registration applications or cases, evidence that the lookup is a no-login public page showing processing status rather than just submitted documents, coverage beyond reemployment tax, hands-on corroboration.
